mirror wall | multi-panel mirror, panel seams ~mid-frame and right, left edge meets door-wall corner | unchanged | seams and edge drift ~20px with camera, internally consistent
real doors + exit signs | near door fully visible, second door beyond mirror edge | unchanged | stable position/size all frames
reflected door wall | two doors + two exit signs inside mirror's left portion, reversed order vs real wall | unchanged | consistent with real door wall across all frames
reflected barre + poster | far wall of reflected room, right side of reflection | unchanged | stable relative to mirror seams
reflected blue bin | back corner of reflected room near door-wall junction | unchanged | stable

dancer | back to camera facing mirror, center-left of frame, feet together | stance widens by 00:06, right arm raised overhead at 00:08 | continuous motion, stays on correct side of mirror, correctly occludes mirror surface
dancer's reflection | mirrors pose with limbs on same image-side as real limbs (verified at 00:00, 00:04, 00:06, 00:08) | consistent at those frames | anomalous limb side at 00:02

findings.description: At 00:02 the dancer's real raised arm passes at/just image-left of her head (hand centered ~at head line, drifting slightly image-left) while her other arm extends to image-right. A plane mirror preserves lateral image position, so the reflected raised arm must appear at/image-left of the reflected head. Instead, the reflection shows the raised arm clearly on the image-RIGHT of the reflected head (~+70px offset vs the real ~-20px offset), placing both reflected arms on the same image-right side of the reflected body. By 00:04 the same left arm is again correctly on the image-left of the reflection, confirming the 00:02 reflection pose is geometrically incompatible with the real pose.
